Passionate about blending machine learning with immersive gaming experiences. Over the past four years, I’ve focused on building scalable AI solutions that enhance player engagement and drive innovation at NexaGame Studios. My work spans from designing ETL pipelines to extract meaningful insights from player data to deploying models on AWS that directly impact game monetization strategies.  

A key project involved developing a recommendation system for in-game purchases, which increased average revenue per user by 18%—a result that underscores the power of data-driven design. I also spearheaded computer vision initiatives to improve player interaction with virtual environments, leveraging PyTorch and TensorFlow to create adaptive AI behaviors.  

Collaborating with cross-functional teams, I’ve optimized workflows using Apache Airflow and Docker, ensuring seamless integration of machine learning models into production. Kubernetes has been instrumental in scaling our infrastructure to handle peak gaming traffic, while GCP provided the backbone for our analytics platforms.  

Beyond technical achievements, I’m driven by the opportunity to shape the future of interactive entertainment. Whether refining reinforcement learning algorithms for dynamic game worlds or exploring NLP for smarter in-game communication, I’m committed to pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in gaming through responsible AI. Let’s build something extraordinary—together.
